explanations: reserveOrder starts one async callback per order line with Array.prototype.forEach, but forEach ignores the promises those callbacks return, so nothing awaits them. The function returns { reserved, failed } while both arrays are still empty, so fulfilOrder sees no failures and ships an empty pick list; the reservations only land later. The fix maps the lines to promises and awaits them with Promise.all, so the result is complete before it is returned.
